# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.2

<!-- update-summary: Prepare media reconnection recovery and incremental lyric rendering; language and glow acceptance remain pending. -->

## Preparation status

This is an unpublished release-note draft. The final language and glow patches have not
been integrated. The requested glow appearance and real-App acceptance remain pending;
the owner's conditional publication instruction has not yet become executable.

## Source changes prepared

- Treat missing Windows media playback information and controls as unavailable candidate
  data so a healthy candidate can still be selected. Observe a faulted refresh consumer
  while continuing subscription retirement and state cleanup on reconnect or shutdown.
- Clear stale song presentation when an unexpected media consumer fault stops observation.
  Keep bounded native-operation ownership until the actual operation completes.
- Reuse lyric rows at stable original indices during progressive translation. Compare
  record values to avoid updating every row when progress clones the full document.
  Each publication still scans O(N) lines; this is not an O(1) or measured memory-leak fix.
- Merge music render requests within a UI frame and cancel queued rendering on the view's
  own hide/unload lifecycle. Ancestor collapse and native HWND hiding remain unverified.

The prepared source changes still need final integration and real-player/UI acceptance.
Language correction and glow visual results must be documented only after their final
patches and verification are available. No new benchmark or model-validation pass is claimed.

## AI Beta limitations retained

AI remains optional and off by default, using the existing pinned Hy-MT2 1.8B and optional
7B Q8 models. Both models remain unverified and `semanticApproved=false`. Original/provider
lyrics and their timings remain available; a matching provider translation takes priority.
The current whole-song ceiling remains 600 seconds. Historical 300-second baseline failures
retain their original outputs, identities and hashes; they do not prove completion under
the current ceiling. Unexecuted 600-second cold/cache, AVX2 and 7B validation stays unexecuted.
Quality and latency limitations do not waive cancellation, cleanup, security or packaging defects.

## Compatibility and publication

v0.3.1-beta.1 is the immediate upgrade baseline. Beta.1 remains immutable. Version metadata
for this candidate derives from `RELEASE_VERSION`: semantic `0.3.1-beta.2`, PE/MSIX `0.3.1.2`.
The Beta channel remains a prerelease channel; Stable downloads remain unchanged.

Publication requires the final main commit, satisfied user conditions, a fresh exact-source
experimental acceptance record with no known blocking defects, and actual Windows/package
evidence. The existing runtime artifact can be reused only if its reviewed bytes and source
identity still match the final candidate. Official website/API metadata comes from the real
Release after publication; no future download or publication date is announced by this draft.
